class.name: NNBehaviourGroup
class.brief_description: Groups related [NNBehaviour] nodes so they can be enabled or gated together.
class.description: Add as a direct child of an [NNAgent] to organize related [NNBehaviour] nodes (for example, "OnFootCombat" and "VehicleCombat") and gate them behind shared considerations. Behaviour groups cannot be nested. When the agent evaluates options, it scores this group's child considerations first; its child behaviours are only evaluated if the group's score meets or exceeds [member activation_score]. This saves work and keeps whole sets of behaviours inactive until a context applies.

members.member: Minimum [member NNBehaviours.score] required before this group's child behaviours are evaluated.

signal.name: behaviour_group_entered
signal.description: Emitted when the agent selects a behaviour inside this group.

signal.name: behaviour_group_exited
signal.description: Emitted when the agent switches away from this group or has no valid candidates left.

signal.name: frame_tick
signal.description: Emitted on every agent step while a behaviour in this group is active.
